narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video seeks to debunk a common internet myth about whether not having children keeps women young, using the speaker's own dermatological expertise and personal experience. It explains that stress (psychological wear and tear) from active parenting leads to facial aging markers like eye bags and wrinkles, effectively promoting the services of the featured dermatology clinic.
